high_level_description: This image appears to be a screenshot from an Instagram Explore page, featuring a post by the account "voompla." The post shows two individuals, a man and a woman, posing closely together for a selfie. Both have their faces painted with vibrant colors, predominantly yellow and red, which are commonly associated with the Holi festival, a Hindu celebration of colors. The man has short, dark hair and is wearing a white shirt. The woman has long, wavy brown hair and is wearing a dark-colored top. They both appear to be smiling and enjoying themselves, suggesting a festive and joyful mood.
